name: docs-manager
description: Treat docs as a product: auto-generated _index.md navigation, broken-link checks, text-source diagrams with typed refs and staleness tracking, a how-to for drawing ERDs that hold up, a method for keeping an agent instruction file (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) small by moving project knowledge into the docs, cards that catalogue external reference files (pdf, office and OpenDocument) with where-to-look maps, runtime-free docx/xlsx/pptx/odt/ods/odp extraction that says what it cannot read, staleness checks that name the docs to review, onboarding of a legacy project (survey its scattered docs, approve a plan, build docs/ with git history and links kept, folder links rewritten, what cannot be rewritten reported), and the docs-as-product conventions, DRY and SOLID read for docs. No renderer, no runtime, no dependencies.
